summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 Skill-input remains historical and cannot auto-promote to v2 authority; v2 assigns candidate roles: normative_source, authority_source, implementation_input, lifecycle_projection, derived_context, execution_evidence, report, ephemeral_attempt; only first three authorize; separate sourceSelectionHash and sourceContentHash; selection binds roles, relative paths, modules, scope, resources, content binds selected bytes; adapter owns transport, ranges, continuation, coverage, truncation and complete bounded-lossy summaries; ready receipts are immutable generations under skill-input-generations/<binding-hash>/ with atomically advanced validated non-authorizing pointer; consumers use pointer only; independent execution/publication/semantic-review gates; Knowledge self-change derived from changed-set and path policy, never caller flag; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects current pointer, lifecycle/authorization/terminal references and active attempts; committed evidence deletion requires maintainer approval plus non-authorizing cleanup receipt; migrate all consumers to v2 before 8-18 creates current receipt; legacy current directories remain immutable evidence pending approved retention; no lifecycle authority, Knowledge publication, or Bootstrap; extends ADR-0048/0050/0057/0058/0059 and supersedes only their v1 selection/current-resolution practices
